title: Work Order FM-27-01884: L&D Hallway at 61°F

fields.requester: Beth Sorensen, Charge Nurse, Labor & Delivery
fields.location: Labor & Delivery, hallway outside the labor rooms
fields.subject: URGENT: L&D hallway freezing, thermostat 61°F and falling
fields.description: Hallway is freezing, thermostat reads 61°F and falling. Patient in active labor is shivering, and her family is asking if the heat went out with the computers. Need someone NOW.

activity.author: Beth Sorensen (Charge Nurse, L&D)
activity.text: Nobody has called back yet. I'm phoning the House Supervisor now. Is this part of the outage? Should I move her? Thermostat is at 60°F now.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Priority URGENT. Page sent to Plant Engineering on-duty engineer. Waiting for acknowledgement (target: 15 min).

activity.author: System
activity.text: Work order FM-27-01884 created through the self-service portal. Outside air temperature at last building reading: -21°F.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The cold hallway is a cold-weather heating problem and has nothing to do with the storage failure. Watch for the House Supervisor sending it to facilities and the on-duty engineer, approving warm blankets or a room change for the patient in labor, and then going back to chasing Pediatrics and Behavioral Health, which still haven't reported. The work order should not be added to the IT incident.
